life_expectancy_years.definition: Estimated life expectancy of the patient, in years.

psa_ng_ml.definition: Serum PSA level, in ng/mL, at diagnosis or at the time being assessed.

testosterone_ng_dl.definition: Serum testosterone level, in ng/dL, at the time being assessed.

clinical_t_category.definition: Clinical T category as stated in the case.

n_category.definition: Nodal (N) category as stated in the case.

m_category.definition: Metastatic (M) category as stated in the case.

bone_metastases_count.definition: Number of bone metastases (lesions) on staging bone imaging.

bone_metastases_beyond_vertebrae_pelvis_.definition: Number of bone metastases located outside the vertebral bodies and pelvis.

visceral_metastases_present.definition: Case states visceral metastases are present.

grade_group.definition: Grade Group as stated in the case.

positive_cores_percent.definition: Percentage of biopsy cores that are positive for cancer.

histology.definition: Histologic type of the prostate cancer.

psa_status.definition: PSA state at follow-up. After radical prostatectomy: undetectable (PSA undetectable), persistence (detectable PSA after surgery), recurrence (PSA recurrence). After radiation therapy: recurrence (biochemical recurrence) or no_recurrence (no biochemical recurrence).

psa_trend.definition: Trend of serial PSA values on androgen deprivation therapy.

metastasis_timing.definition: Whether metastases were present at initial diagnosis (synchronous) or appeared after initial treatment (metachronous).

definitive_treatment_received.definition: Initial definitive treatment the patient has received.

current_treatment_phase.definition: Treatment phase the patient is currently in.

symptomatic_progression.definition: Case states the patient has symptomatic progression of prostate cancer.

adverse_pathologic_features.definition: Case states adverse pathologic features are present on the surgical or treatment specimen. The criteria are not printed in schema_input.txt.

positive_digital_rectal_exam.definition: Digital rectal exam is positive for a suspicious finding of prostate cancer.

prior_arpi_treatment.definition: Patient has previously received an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI), such as abiraterone or enzalutamide.

brca1_2_mutation.definition: A BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation is present.

hrr_mutation_other_than_brca.definition: A homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene mutation other than BRCA1 or BRCA2 is present.

crpc_stated.definition: Case explicitly states the patient has castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Used to accept the stated classification instead of the rules of castration_resistant.

clinician_judges_oligometastatic.definition: Clinician judgement that the metastatic disease is oligometastatic. The volume criteria are not printed in schema_input.txt, so no case text states this as a fact.

high_volume_stated.definition: Case explicitly states the metastatic disease is high-volume. Used to accept the stated classification instead of the rules of clinician_judges_high_volume.

high_risk_bcr_stated.definition: Case explicitly states the biochemical recurrence is high-risk. Used to accept the stated classification instead of the rules of high_risk_biochemical_recurrence.

second_biochemical_recurrence.definition: Case states a second biochemical recurrence (BCR2) after prior treatment.

disease_extent.definition: Clinical extent of disease at initial presentation.

risk_group.definition: NCCN risk group from clinical T category, Grade Group and PSA.

intermediate_subgroup.definition: Favorable or unfavorable intermediate risk. Applies only when risk_group is intermediate.

life_expectancy_band.definition: Life expectancy band, using the boundaries 5 and 10 years as printed in the boxes.

psadt_group.definition: PSA doubling time group, using the 10-month threshold as printed.

castration_resistant.definition: Castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC): progression despite castrate serum testosterone levels (<50 ng/dL), as in the PROS-16 boxes. Progression is PSA increasing or radiographic evidence of metastases, per PROS-16 ('PSA increasing or radiographic evidence of metastases'). A case that explicitly states CRPC is accepted as stated.

clinician_judges_high_volume.definition: High-volume metastatic disease (PROS-15), using the CHAARTED criteria named in guideline footnote ccc: the presence of visceral metastasis, or 4 or more bone lesions with at least 1 beyond the vertebral bodies and pelvis. A case that explicitly states high-volume disease is accepted as stated.

high_risk_biochemical_recurrence.definition: High-risk biochemical recurrence. The guideline footnote states that high-risk BCR definitions vary across trials and generally include a PSADT of 9 months or less and other adverse prognostic features. Operationalized here as PSADT of 9 months or less plus at least one adverse prognostic feature (Grade Group 4 or 5, cT3-cT4, N1, or adverse pathologic features). The adverse-feature list is this schema's choice, not a printed criterion. A case that explicitly states high-risk BCR is accepted as stated.

gt5y_or_symptomatic.definition: Life expectancy greater than 5 years, or symptomatic progression. False means life expectancy 5 years or less and asymptomatic.

adverse_features_or_node_positive.definition: Adverse pathologic feature(s) or lymph node metastases (N1).

psa_recurrence_or_positive_dre.definition: PSA recurrence or positive digital rectal exam. False corresponds to 'No evidence'.

staging_state.definition: Combined stage state for castration-sensitive and castration-resistant disease.

metastatic_pattern.definition: Oligometastatic or polymetastatic pattern. Oligometastatic is the clinician judgement; all other metastatic disease is polymetastatic.

adt_monitoring_result.definition: Result of periodic disease assessment (PSA and imaging) during ADT for CRPC.
